obernants.operator: With C concepts, L links, text bytes N and K cue occurrences, lexical scanning is O(K*N) up to form allocation/string costs; path O(C+reached_nodes*L) time and O(C) storage. Consequences can call path for O(C^2) found pairs before bounded chain scans. Expressions have at most six span lengths and O(6) candidates per span, BTreeMap lookup O(log E) comparisons plus string work and duplicate-row scans. Lazy index construction scales with included bytes; no latency measurement or whole-engine bound is implied.
